# Pull Request Checklist – RPG Feature

Thank you for your contribution! Please check all items that apply before submitting.

## Code / Script
- [ ] Code compiles and runs without errors
- [ ] No debug/test logs left
- [ ] Naming conventions followed
- [ ] Unused variables/functions removed
- [ ] Comments added for complex logic
- [ ] Edge cases handled
- [ ] Performance check passed

## Feature / Gameplay
- [ ] Feature works as intended
- [ ] Interactions with other systems verified
- [ ] Player experience flows correctly
- [ ] Known bugs flagged

## Assets (if applicable)
- [ ] Assets in correct folders
- [ ] Naming conventions followed
- [ ] Assets optimized
- [ ] Prefabs/objects properly linked

## Testing
- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] Manual testing complete
- [ ] No regressions
- [ ] Edge cases tested

## Version Control / Git
- [ ] Branch up-to-date with main/development
- [ ] No merge conflicts
- [ ] Commits clean and descriptive
- [ ] PR description includes:
  - Summary of changes
  - Known issues
  - Dependencies

## Documentation
- [ ] README or docs updated if needed
- [ ] TODOs / limitations clearly noted
